name: 45426 · Trotwood, OH
findings: ZIP 45426 (Trotwood) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45426 (Trotwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45426 (Trotwood) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
